_template_notes: work-plan.json — Kế hoạch thực thi từ Phase 3 Plan. Schema: work-plan-v2 (v10.11.0 — align template với script output route-and-write.sh §3.9). Writer: scripts/wf-fix-bugs/route-and-write.sh.
_schema_notes: Required: $schema, session_id, generated_at, execution_mode, profile, dimensions[], workload_count, agent_count_estimate, total_estimated_issues, playwright. execution_mode ∈ {inline, agent_dispatch}. profile ∈ {quick, standard, deep, exhaustive}. dimensions[] item: string (QD ID). dimensions_applied = dimensions sau ISG refinement. playwright {enabled:bool, mode:'none|headless|visible|mobile', order:string[], devices:string[]}. mobile_devices[] item: string (vd 'iPhone 14'). workload_ratio = workload_count / threshold (CDG-11). Consumer: Phase 4 lane dispatch (đọc dimensions + execution_mode + playwright config), Phase 7 reports.
